name: LEGEND COOKWARE 5-Ply Stainless Steel Cookware Set
imageAlt: LEGEND COOKWARE 5-Ply Stainless Steel Cookware Set
description: LEGEND COOKWARE 5-Ply Stainless Steel Cookware Set, 14-Piece Pots and Pans Set - Induction Compatible, Oven Safe 800°F - Non-Toxic, No Coatings - Built to Last Generations
features: 5-PLY STAINLESS STEEL COOKWARE HEATS EVENLY – Five layers of steel and aluminum spread heat evenly and retain heat. No hot spots. Food cooks perfectly edge to center.
NON-TOXIC STAINLESS STEEL POTS AND PANS. NO COATINGS – Food touches only pure steel. No forever chemicals, no toxins. Safe for your family at any heat.

INDUCTION COMPATIBLE. OVEN SAFE TO 800°F – This stainless steel pots and pans set works flawlessly on gas, electric, induction, and glass cooktops. Start on the stove, finish in the oven up to 800°F without switching pans.
POLISHED STAINLESS STEEL – Not nonstick—preheat and add oil to prevent sticking. Flared sealed rims pour without drips. Hand wash recommended.
HEAVY DUTY COOKWARE BUILT TO LAST GENERATIONS – Extra-thick 3mm steel won't warp under high heat. Cast hollow riveted handles stay cooler and secure through daily use.
